shots.name: coronado_bridge_tidelands
shots.check: const d = en.sky.decks[0], K = d.loc.K, t = en.sky.tools, p = t.pointAt(d, K.ch); return { channel_s: Math.round(K.ch), L: Math.round(d.loc.L), deck_at_channel: +t.deckY(d, K.ch, p.x, p.z).toFixed(1), deckAt: en.world.deckAt(p.x, p.z), off: en.world.deckAt(p.x + 200, p.z + 200) };

shots.name: coronado_helo_ferry
shots.check: const k = en.sky; return { helos: (k.heloList || []).map(h => [Math.round(h.alt / 0.3048), Math.round(h.v)]), vessels: (k.vesselList || []).map(v => v.kind + ' ' + v.v.toFixed(1)) };

shots.name: coronado_night_bridge
shots.check: const k = en.sky; return { lamps: k.lampSet ? k.lampSet.ib.count : -1, night: en.graphics().night, sunAlt: en.graphics().sunAlt };
